thread:
alexa: heads-up — after the us-west2 rack reboot we have ~30 tiny-gpu pods stuck PENDING. Scheduler shows available fractional GPU on several nodes but pods won't pack.
mason: which error in pod status? Image pull, PV, or scheduling?
alexa: scheduling. message: "0/24 nodes are available: 12 Insufficient gpu, 8 node(s) had taint mycompany/gpu-maintenance:NoSchedule, 4 node(s) didn't match PodAntiAffinity."
priya: are these pods requesting topology-specific PVs? last time pv affinity blocked backfill
alexa: yes some use local-ssd PVs bound to nodes that are now cordoned during the rack reboot. So scheduler can't move them, but many tiny pods are still PENDING because they require <1 GPU and we have fragmented fractional capacity.
mason: autoscaler should create new nodes to fill pending, why didn't it? autoscaler-bot: "scale blocked: quotaExceeded in us-west2-a (IP quota)"
jin: oof. So we have two blockers: PV affinity preventing reschedule to free nodes, and quota preventing scale-up. Can we uncordon nodes and evict PV-bound pods to make room?
alexa: uncordon would let some move but PVs are strict. We could force-delete pods and let them recreate, but that would lose local-ssd data. These are ephemeral training jobs though, probably ok to restart.
priya: before nuking, can we soft-affinity pack tiny pods onto nodes with leftover fractional GPUs? Scheduler's binpack plugin seems to treat fractional GPU as unusable if taints exist.
mason: also saw NIC saturation on a couple nodes during drain -> causes kubelet eviction spikes; that contributes to failed scheduling attempts and thrash.
ops-oncall: current plan: 1) temporarily lift PV affinity on the non-critical jobs (mark them to allow nodeAffinity fallback). 2) request quota bump for us-west2-a (contact infra infra-quotas). 3) run a targeted evict of ephemeral tiny pods to let scheduler coalesce them onto defragmented nodes. 4) monitor autoscaler-bot for scale events.
alexa: steps 1-3 in motion. doing a dry-run evict on a small subset now.
jin: long-term: propose we enable fractional-gpu packing policy that allows sub-GPU binpacking for tiny pods + allow scheduler to treat local PVs with softer topology constraints when pods are labeled ephemeral.
priya: +1. also add a pre-drain hook to unbind ephemeral PVs or migrate workload so rack reboots don't leave tiny pods stranded.
mason: noted. logging follow-up in infra runbook.
autoscaler-bot: "scale activity: request submitted to cloud quota team. ETA 45m."
ops-oncall: monitoring: GPU utilization pct on us-west2 cluster: pre-fix 62%, wasted-fragmented slots ~13%. will update if eviction dry-run succeeds.
alexa: eviction dry-run succeeded for 5 pods, 4 rescheduled onto nodes with fractional capacity. doing wider rollout now. thanks all :thumbsup:
